Patient: I don't recall having any previous knee injuries or surgeries. Since the injury, my knee hasn't locked up or clicked, but it does feel unstable, and I'm definitely favoring it when I walk. Doctor: Could you describe the current level of pain in your knee on a scale from 1 to 10, and have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your leg?
